correctness.rationale: Pointwise generator identities exactly account for r(n-1) flexible clocks and (r-1)n possible donors; stationary carré-du-champ gives L2 shore synchronization O_r(1/n). Accelerated generator has drift 1-rp and diffusion p_a(delta_ab-p_b). Polynomial stationarity forces unique Dirichlet(1,...,1) moment solution. 1012 exact rational local-identity states and a complete 27-state stationary balance certificate independently verify finite claims, not the infinity proof.

originality.rationale: The closest well-mixed result proves a finite flat composition law on complete graphs, which provably fails for this multipartite graph; its conclusion does not entail our asymptotic theorem. Interacting clique work has within-shore links and different limit; two-opinion bipartite zealot results cover only one-dimensional Beta; the star opinion-graph conditional terminal Dirichlet is a different process. Targeted public records and primary full text do not establish this fixed-r>=3 theorem. Residual risk of unindexed equivalent general-density theorem acknowledged.

value.rationale: A motivated complete family of dense yet non-fully-mixed stochastic spin-copying networks exhibits a universal non-self-averaging Dirichlet stationary limit, while its smallest exact finite law contradicts the known complete-graph flat composition property. Exact finite means and a full multivariate convergence theorem distinguish it from routine single-moment computations.
